lines: A wrong link or a failing server should never leave anyone stranded.
Open a link that no longer exists, and the member app says Page not found, keeps the address, and moves focus to the heading.
Two links lead back, Go to home and Browse events, by touch or by keyboard.
Staff see the same screen in the admin console, with Go to dashboard and Manage events.
When the server fails while a screen loads, the app says Something went wrong, owns the failure, and offers Try again.
Every server error from the API now carries a reference, built from the request's trace, so a member can quote it and an operator can find it.
A crafted link cannot put its own words there, and Try again only returns to a page inside the app.
Both screens load only when needed. The first load is two hundred and twenty kilobytes, under the limit of two hundred and fifty.
Every test failed first. Now fourteen browser specs, forty-three unit tests and the API tests pass.
Next, the first screen that loads data switches on the interceptor.
That's slice thirty point one. Christian Fitness: a Christian community for health in body and spirit.
